null_recovery_round8_2026_07_03.valuation_765m: 765,000,000 SGD = independent valuation of Mapletree Anson as at 31 March 2024 by CBRE Pte. Ltd. Printed p13 ('...secured a S$10.0 million gain over the property's independent valuation of S$765.0 million...'), p41 ('The divestment consideration of S$775.0 million exceeded the property's independent valuation of S$765.0 million as at 31 March 2024 by S$10.0 million'), and Portfolio Statement p117 (Mapletree Anson row: 'At valuation as at 31/03/2024' = 765,000 $'000; FY2025 column shows '—' because divested).
null_recovery_round8_2026_07_03.carrying_value_765m: 765,000,000 SGD = carrying amount removed on disposal per Note 14 INVESTMENT PROPERTIES movement schedule, p146: 'Divestment of an investment property | (765,000) | – | (765,000) | –' (identical (765,000) $'000 in both Group and MPACT columns).
null_recovery_round8_2026_07_03.why_genuine_not_conflation: Under the IAS 40 fair-value model, an investment property's carrying amount IS its most recent fair value. Mapletree Anson's last valuation before the 31 Jul 2024 disposal was S$765.0m as at 31 Mar 2024; no revaluation was booked in the stub period, so the carrying amount removed on disposal (765,000) legitimately equals the independent valuation (765,000). These are TWO independent disclosures (Note 14 movement vs. valuation narrative/Portfolio Statement) that print the same number — not one column copied into another. Consideration S$775.0m > valuation/carrying S$765.0m by S$10.0m (accounting gain over valuation); net gain on divestment after costs = S$4,006k (p146).
